# Obsidian Mods

Obsidian Mods is a Minecraft Dungeons II (Minecraft Dungeons 2) mod platform and cross-platform mod manager for Windows and Linux.

## Important pages
- Home: https://mixutin.github.io/ObsidianMods/
- Discover Minecraft Dungeons II mods: https://mixutin.github.io/ObsidianMods/discover.html
- Obsidian Mods Manager: https://mixutin.github.io/ObsidianMods/manager.html
- Native F8 in-game mod menu: https://mixutin.github.io/ObsidianMods/overlay.html
- Mod package format: https://mixutin.github.io/ObsidianMods/package-format.html
- GitHub: https://github.com/mixutin/ObsidianMods

## Key capabilities
- Minecraft Dungeons II mod discovery
- one-click mod installation
- Windows and Linux support
- native in-game F8 menu
- native Obsidian plugins
- PAK / IoStore packages
- UE4SS compatibility
- SHA-256 verified downloads
- profiles, backups and Vanilla mode
